Agentic AI Test Automation
Home
Agentic AI Test Automation
Intelligent AI Automation for Reliable Software Delivery
Market Cloud helps organisations modernise software testing with
Agentic Test Automation
that combines proven automation frameworks, intelligent decision-making and AI-assisted execution.
Our approach enables QA and engineering teams to transform testing from a largely manual and repetitive activity into an intelligent, scalable and continuously integrated process.
How We Help
AI-Powered Test Automation
– Leverage AI agents to intelligently plan, execute and adapt testing activities based on application behaviour and test requirements.
End-to-End Automation
– Automate functional, regression, integration and API testing across complex applications and digital platforms.
Reduced Manual Effort
– Minimise repetitive test execution and allow QA teams to focus on higher-value quality engineering and exploratory activities.
Improved Regression Coverage
– Increase the breadth and frequency of regression testing while reducing the time required to validate releases.
Business Outcomes
Release software faster
Without compromising quality.
Build greater confidence in every release through faster, more consistent and data-driven testing.
Reduce testing cost
By lowering dependence on repetitive manual execution.
Increase test coverage
Across critical applications and business processes.
Improve defect detection
Earlier in the development lifecycle.
Reduce regression risk
As applications evolve and new functionality is introduced.
Increase QA productivity
By allowing teams to focus on quality strategy and complex testing challenges.
Agentic Test Automation Services
Automation Strategy & Consulting
Assess your current testing processes and define a practical automation roadmap aligned with your applications, delivery model and quality goals using AI.
Test Automation Services
Design and deploy scalable automation frameworks for functional, regression, API and end-to-end testing across your technology landscape using agentic AI.
Managed services
Extend your QA capability with continuous automation execution, framework maintenance, monitoring and ongoing optimisation using agentic AI.
QA Staff Augmentaion
Add experienced automation engineers to your existing QA or development teams when you need specialist skills or flexible capacity.
AI-Assisted Automation
Use AI-supported techniques to improve test design, scenario generation, risk identification and execution efficiency.
Functional Automation
Automate critical business workflows and application features to improve validation speed and consistency across releases.
Regression Automation
Build repeatable regression suites that help teams identify defects quickly after application changes.
API & Integration Automation
Validate APIs, connected systems and data exchanges to ensure reliable end-to-end application behaviour.
CI/CD Test Integration
Integrate automated testing into delivery pipelines to provide faster feedback throughout development and deployment.
